summary: Iteration 13 completed targeted and full-stack validation of the five new hosters, host editor, key-test behavior, Security tab, Login-Warnungen, Anti-Adblock persistence, secret masking, mirror creation, public player, and dashboard regression. Targeted backend tests passed 9/9; full regression passed 62/63, with the known credentialed-CORS preflight failure. Desktop UI flows passed. Mobile Security remains severely horizontally clipped.

critical.issue: Credentialed CORS still fails through the public deployment: preflight returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and omits Access-Control-Allow-Credentials. FastAPI is also configured from CORS_ORIGINS='*'.

The endpoint allowlist still accepts only doodstream/voe/firestream, so Playmate, Vidara, Streamtape, Vinovo, and VidNest are unconditionally rejected as unsupported even though find_replacement implements them.

minor.issue: Alert lock state is inaccurate: after 3 failed logins the UI/API showed locked=true/gesperrt, although login enforcement uses 5 attempts per account and 20 per IP. locked_until is written on every failure and the alert endpoint does not apply the threshold when deriving locked.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px, document width is 756px and security-panel is 672px wide with x=-334; the left half of Turnstile, Anti-Adblock, and Login-Warnungen content is clipped.

integration_issues.issue: The Security tab labels an IP as 'gesperrt' after only 3 failures because it trusts the backend's inaccurate locked flag.

issues: Page-level horizontal overflow reaches 756px on a 390px viewport.
Security panel is shifted left off-screen, making labels and controls partly unreadable/unusable.

action_items: Configure explicit allowed frontend origin(s) at ingress and FastAPI, with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true for credentialed requests.
Extend autofix_link's provider allowlist and provider-specific credential validation to the five new providers so their implemented find_replacement branches are reachable.
Derive Login-Warnung locked status using the same thresholds as login enforcement, and align German UI text with the actual per-account/per-IP limits.
Fix mobile Admin Security layout so the page and panel remain within 390px without negative positioning or page-level horizontal overflow.
Ensure provider request exceptions and logs redact API keys embedded in query-string URLs.
critical_code_review_comments: validate_api_key and api_resolve_link interpolate API keys into URLs; returning/logging raw requests exceptions can expose the full query URL. Redact credentials before sending toast messages or logs.
get_current_user still chooses the cookie before an explicit Bearer header, so mismatched credentials can silently act as the cookie identity.
server.py is 1859 lines, far above the 700-line threshold; split auth/security, host integrations, mirrors, settings, admin users, and jobs into focused modules.
Static analysis reports three duplicate NAME_TO_ISO keys in server.py, and AdminDashboard.jsx fails ESLint on an unescaped quote in the Streamtape help text.
The prior fix-log regression test depended on pre-seeded history and failed when the collection was validly empty; it was corrected to validate zero-or-more response entries.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested desktop/E2E flows passed; mobile Security layout failed)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_ users, hosts, mirrors, failed-login counters, and UI mirror data. Users/hosts/mirrors and login alerts were cleaned; Anti-Adblock and Turnstile were left false. Existing auto-fix regression creates history rows for which no cleanup API exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop verified: admin login, exactly 8 seeded hosters, all 8 provider options, Streamtape API-Login, FireStream login block, disabled no-key test button, all Security sections, warning clear, Anti-Adblock true/false persistence, /e/<slug>, and dashboard. Final public settings have antiadblock_enabled=false and turnstile_enabled=false. Re-test CORS, new-provider autofix reachability, accurate locked status, and Security at 390px.
rca_of_the_issue: CORS is intercepted/configured as wildcard without credentials. New-provider auto-fix code is unreachable because autofix_link retains the old three-provider guard. Login alerts mark any future locked_until as locked even though enforcement separately checks count thresholds. Mobile overflow comes from desktop-width admin content/tab layout expanding and shifting the security panel outside the viewport.
